_doc: Genes that have not been shown to fire in any committed screen, and why.
The shape is `tools/inert_waivers.json`'s: a flat {tag: reason} map. Unlike
that file the reason is ENFORCED -- `tools/gene_fires.py` fails a waiver
shorter than 40 characters -- and a waiver goes STALE, failing the same
`--max 0` ratchet, the moment its gene is proven by a committed screen row
or leaves the gene tables. The list can only shrink.
Almost every entry here is grandfathered: it was in the tables before a new
gene had to show it fires. A gene added AFTER 2026-08-23 should not appear
here at all -- #2330 wrote rows for eighteen behaviours, the gate refused
four of them on their own probes, and those four were removed from the
To clear an entry: run a single-gene probe, which holds every other gene at
the baseline so any divergence is this gene alone, and commit the analysis --
-- then DELETE the entry here, or the stale-waiver check fails.

waivers.capital-archers-before-the-surprise-2: Opt-in, not armed: version two of capital-archers-before-the-surprise (waived above for the same reason) that adds one reading, only in the opening (Online turn 45): a watched major's soldier within six tiles of our unwalled original capital in the watch's window arms the spending legs at 2.5x our power instead of 3.5x. The single-gene Emperor probe at the ledger baseline rarely reaches it. A live game shared the host, so the evidence is paired Immortal war-rate screens against the gene-off arm (PR for this tag); the unit tests in src/ai/advanced/capital_archers_before_the_surprise/tests.rs pin the door, the opening, the six tiles and the Walls. Clear with an armed live game's 'capital-archers-before-the-surprise:' why.log lines naming the opening door.
waivers.score-seat-raises-wonders-3: Opt-in, not armed; version 3 of score-seat-raises-wonders (enabling it turns versions 1 and 2 off) and acts only on a Score target during version 2's safety-first hold, so a fires probe needs a score target in its mix, rivals that threaten and the family together. It runs on the native engine path; the PR's paired Immortal Rome, 6-player Continents, score-target sim with the war-rate rivals measures it (40 pairs at 160 turns: the rear lane opened in 31 games, 15 turns a game, and started a race in 17). The unit tests in src/ai/advanced/score_wonders/tests.rs pin each gate against versions 1 and 2: a rear city races through a threat hold, the capital and a frontier city beside the threat do not, the capital races when it is itself the rear, war at the gates (a threatened or lately attacked city, a Recovery plan) shuts the lane, and a rear race whose city stops qualifying is held.
waivers.denial-spies-cover-every-racer: Opt-in re-ranking of racer-keeps-the-spies' Spy pick (live Immortal civvis-20261115T212021Z, Culture seat, lost to India's Science Victory while 9 of 13 Disrupt Rocketry went to Persia). It acts only with racer-keeps-the-spies and the space-denial Spy network armed (opt-in, off at the ledger baseline, armed live), a Spy of ours afield and two or more racers within a project of each other; the native screen's Spies never reach a rival pad, so a single-gene probe at the baseline reads identical arms. The unit tests in src/ai/advanced/denial_spies_cover_every_racer/tests.rs pin both arms (off: the stock leader takes every Spy; on: three level racers get one each, a doubled Spy moves to the uncovered racer, a racer two projects ahead takes them all, Science breaks a tie, the journal names the racers and their projects), and PR #5390 replays the live decision frames t156-198 with the gene off and on. Clear with an armed game's 'denial-spies-cover-every-racer:' why.log lines.
waivers.denial-spies-fill-every-slot-2: Version two of denial-spies-fill-every-slot (operator 2026-11-15: the live focus is a Score win and a rival Science Victory ends most Score games early). On a Culture or Domination aim it is version one line for line, which fires (docs/gene_screens/fires/denial-spies-fill-every-slot.action-pairs.json); its one addition is the Score aim, and it acts only with science-denial-trains-spies (opt-in, off at the ledger baseline, armed live) and the Science Victory on, so a single-gene probe at the baseline never reaches it. The unit tests in src/ai/advanced/denial_spies_fill_every_slot/tests.rs pin the Score branch (version one trains no Spy on a Score aim; version two fills both slots in the two best cities, keeps the Culture aim, never a Science aim) and that enabling it turns version one off. Clear with an armed Score game's captured_native_action_pairs_v1 artifact.
waivers.score-seat-sprints-to-the-tally: fires only on a Score seat in the last 20 turns before a turn limit; live verdict
waivers.score-seat-sprints-to-the-tally-2: fires only on a Score seat in the last 30 turns before a turn limit (version 2 of score-seat-sprints-to-the-tally); live verdict
